title: Validate HTTP content and source access outcomes
objective: Type normal source failures so HTTP 200 and reachability cannot contaminate metadata or become payload/API success. Persist sanitized latest-attempt/last-good evidence on the existing PR010 journal without a second store.
outcome: Census Missing Key HTTP 200 HTML cannot be JSON success. EPA developer-directory 301 to Widgets cannot yield an actionable API recipe. Later typed failure updates latest_attempt while preserving same-kind last-good.

commits.subject: Define content-aware response classification
commits.instructions: Extend existing classifier/client/transport. Separate authentication-required, unavailable, content-mismatch and transient failures. Validate final resource role against requested documentation/API/data role after redirects; retain requested URL, redirect chain and final destination. Use the pinned Census Missing Key and EPA Widgets retained observations.
commits.verification: Census HTTP 200 text/html Missing Key makes JSON success impossible. EPA requested data-data-products#apis resolving to /developers/widgets is destination_resource_role_mismatch; reachability is not an actionable recipe.

commits.subject: Enforce read and expansion bounds
commits.instructions: Apply time/byte/row/redirect caps before passing bytes to parsers; stop and preserve the reason when a limit is reached. Reuse source policy validation. Local fixtures only.
commits.verification: A source ignoring requested limits, an interrupted response and compressed data exceeding the expanded-byte cap fail closed with typed reasons.

commits.subject: Persist useful attempt evidence
commits.instructions: Add exact journal kind attempt_evidence to the existing LocalCollectionStore KINDS allowlist. Add recordAttemptEvidence and evidenceStatus on createLocalCollector. Derive latest_attempt/last_good from the one immutable stream and durable intent order. Keep documentation_reachability, payload_validation, browser_cors_observation and catalog_metadata_validation as separate series. Do not invent a second journal or in-memory authority.
commits.verification: A later same-kind failure updates latest_attempt and retains byte-identical last-good proof across process restart. Cross-kind success never supplies another kind's last-good. Current fixture admission remains one attempt per child for source_fixture_catalog.
